q1.question: How would you describe your playstyle as a quarterback?

options.text: Field General — I'm accurate, aware, and always on time with my reads.
Strong Arm — I trust my arm to fit the ball into windows other guys can't.
Improviser — I create when the play breaks down, not just when it works.
Scrambler — my legs are a weapon defenses have to account for.

options.text: Every time it's there — I don't force anything.

q4.question: Where does that speed actually come from?

options.text: I ran track — sprints or hurdles — before I ever focused on football.

options.text: Make the first guy miss in space and turn it into a chunk play.

q1.question: How would you describe your playstyle as a linebacker?

options.text: Field General — I'm the one getting everyone lined up and making the calls.
Pass Coverage — I match up with backs and tight ends all over the field.
Run Stopper — I live downhill, taking on blocks and finishing tackles.
